## What is a CSV file? 

* A delimited text file that uses a comma to separate values.
* A file that stores tabular data in plain text. 
    * Each line of the file is a single observation in the data.
    * Each observation consists of one or more variables, separated by commas.
*  One of the simplest ways to save data and make it portable. 
    * R, and all other common statistics/data software, can read in .csv files.
